Item.Value: SELECT *, (SELECT Count(*) as Total FROM zt_user_mailinfo WHERE user_sn = '{0}' AND mailbox_code= z.mailbox_code AND trash_flag = 0 AND read_flag ='0') as MailCount FROM zt_user_mailbox z WHERE z.user_sn = '{0}' order by z.levels, z.mailbox_name, z.upper_mailbox_code

WITH TmpTBL AS (SELECT Row_Number() over (order by u.create_time desc) AS RowNum, m.mail_subject, m.from_email, m.from_name, u.state_code, u.create_time, u.mail_sn, u.email_account, u.mailbox_code, u.read_flag FROM zt_user_mailInfo u inner join zt_mail_message m on u.mail_sn = m.mail_sn WHERE u.user_sn = '{0}' AND u.mailbox_code='{1}' AND u.trash_flag = 0) SELECT * FROM TmpTBL WHERE RowNum Between (({2}-1) * {3}) + 1 and {2} * {3}

SELECT m.mail_subject, u.create_time, m.from_email, m.from_name, (select mail_body from zt_mail_body where body_sn=m.body_sn) as body, u.mail_sn FROM zt_user_mailInfo u inner join zt_mail_message m on u.mail_sn = m.mail_sn WHERE u.user_sn = '{0}' AND u.mailbox_code='{1}' AND u.mail_sn = '{2}'
